text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Finance Minister Ronald Penza warned ruling party members in parliament to refrain from insulting donors because the country still needed their support.
- A Zambian woman has been abducted by Zaireans over apparent differences over a maize sale deal.
- The University Teaching hospital says it will take Siamese twins born last week to South Africa for medical investigation.
- Zimbabwe Human Rights (Zimrights) has expressed concern at growing human rights abuses in Zambia.
- Zamnet Communications Systems has launched a high speed link to the internet via a satellite-based service, the PanamSat-3.
